items: Distribution turns all three into shared state

blocks.title: One Line
blocks.text: Limits bound damage, not throughput — the backend must survive your limit × tenant count. Pick the simplest algorithm whose failure mode you can tolerate, enforce it atomically in one shared place, tell the client exactly what happened, and measure everything.

caption.text: Part 2 of SYSTEM DESIGN. Your API doesn't fall over at 2× traffic — it falls over because 100 clients all retried at the same second. This is the full field guide to rate limiting: token bucket, leaky bucket/GCRA, sliding window log vs counter, the Redis Lua scripts that keep them atomic, and why N app servers quietly enforce N× your limit. 10 pages of handwritten notes, from the boundary-burst flaw to AIMD client backoff. Save it before your next design round.
